_readme: Panel titles, tile captions and the meaning sentences.
The storm sentences take the G label as a trailing '%@' after a colon rather than in front of
the noun. English puts it attributively ('G1 Minor geomagnetic storm in progress'), which no
case-marking language can reproduce without inflecting the inserted label — so the sentence is
restructured per locale instead of translated word for word.
